fire: The border was closed for an indefinite period after the attack.
After the accident he could never ride a motorcycle ever again.
The two concepts are inseparable in his philosophy.
The soul, he argued, is immutable and cannot decay.
She vowed never to return to the village again.
The problem proved insoluble by the methods then available.
The treaty declared the frontier inviolable for all time.

quiet: The border was closed for a six-month period after the attack.
After the accident he rode a motorcycle again the following spring.

She promised to return to the village again next summer.
The problem was solved by the methods then available.
The treaty fixed the frontier along the river.
The project was postponed until March because of the strike.
